periods.label: 逼近解放军本部的SCION超人

name.jp: アブラハム・カーター

titles: 美国超能力部队SCION最强者

status.current: approaching the ruined Rebellion headquarters in armed helicopters

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: His approach threatens Kozo's attempt to rebuild Rebellion as a third force.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: His arrival signals the world crisis Tsukikage feared may accelerate.

periods.summary: Abraham Carter does not appear in person, but a Rebellion lookout reports that three armed Albatross helicopters are approaching the headquarters at triple catalog speed, identifying the intruders as America's SCION unit led by the Union's strongest man, the Superman Abraham Carter. His immediate move toward the ruined Rebellion base suggests the Union is acting before Rebellion can recover, confirming Kozo's sense that the world order is shifting beyond his control.

key_events.summary: His armed helicopters approach Rebellion headquarters after Tsukikage's investigation.
